skip_reason: This is a confirmation/booking call for a previously quoted move, not a sales call. The customer states 'my husband actually called your company a few days ago to request a quote' and they are calling to 'reconfirm the code and finalize the booking.' Jules has the quote already prepared ($475.70–$570 or $500–$600 depending on date), never asks discovery questions, never establishes concerns, never delivers the Two Promises, and never positions this as a sales interaction. The entire call is logistics confirmation after the sale was already closed on a prior call. This does not fit the '15-Minute Quote Call' rubric, which grades inbound sales calls where pricing and positioning happen in real time.
